expectations.text: At least one documentation file contains BOTH a '## Before You Begin' section (with a prerequisite list or checklist) AND a '## What You Will Learn' section (with bulleted learning outcomes). Both sections must appear in the same file. A file with only one of the two does NOT satisfy this — both are required for a Tutorial per the skill's Phase 3 specification.

Timing-based language like 'Read First: Yes' or 'Week 1' does NOT satisfy this — the P0/P1/P2 scheme is required.
